premises: Slower cooling after solution treatment induces serrated grain boundaries in HEAs
Serrated grain boundaries distribute strains more evenly than straight boundaries
More even strain distribution delays grain boundary decohesion and crack initiation
Delayed crack initiation permits energy-dissipating microstructural changes (e.g., amorphization, nanobridges) near crack tips
